name: TheSaaSDir

sources.title: TheSaaSDir homepage — curated SaaS/AI directory, 300+ products, submit offers
Sister site submit form — identical 4-step flow incl. badge verification and plan tiers

conditions: Free submission is a badge exchange — embed their dofollow badge on your site (the sister site's identical flow verifies the badge inside the submit form)
requirements: SaaS/AI products — categories include AI, NoCode, DevTools, API, CRM, Marketing, Finance, etc.
No account needed — 'Submit for free with a badge exchange ... No account needed' per the homepage
Up to 3 categories per product (per the sister form)
preparation: Product URL (the form auto-fills details from it)
Name, tagline, description, screenshot, tags, contact email
Badge HTML deployed on your site before submitting (verification is part of the flow)
workflow: Enter the product URL and let auto-fill populate details
Confirm product details, categories and email
Choose Free / Get Featured $19 / Multiple Listings $29
Free: embed badge, verify, submit; paid tiers skip the badge
watchFor: Multiple Listings ($29) publishes on BOTH TheSaaSDir and TheAIToolsDir for one price — different sibling pairing than TheDevToolsDir's bundle
Badge link must be dofollow for verification (same badge pattern as thedevtoolsdir.com)
Same operator runs TheDevToolsDir — don't pay for both single listings if the $29 dual option covers your target
Expect a honeypot field in the form (sister form has 'Leave this field empty')
countsAsLive: A public product page at thesaasdir.com/product/<slug>/ appearing under its categories.
unknowns: Exact form fields and review latency — the submit page wasn't fetched directly (sister site's form used as reference)
Whether free outbound links are dofollow before/without badge verification
